responses.ORDER_MEASUREMENTS_UPDATED: Measurements updated — the tailor will cut with the new ones

lookup.title: Follow your ao dai
lookup.subtitle: Enter your order code and the phone number or email used on the order — no sign-in needed.
lookup.orderCodeHint: Found in your confirmation email / text
lookup.privacyNote: For privacy, this page only shows progress. Address, measurements and workshop photos are behind the link in your confirmation email.
lookup.linkHint: Want workshop photos or to change measurements? Open the “Follow tailoring progress” link in your confirmation email.
lookup.emptyTitle: Every ao dai has its journey
lookup.emptyDescription: Enter your order code to see which step your piece is at: measurements, cutting, sewing, final check or on its way.

track.title: Your ao dai's journey
track.subtitle: This link is view-only. To change measurements or the address, the atelier texts a verification code to the order's phone number.

missing.title: Tracking link missing
missing.description: Open the link in your confirmation email, or look the order up by code and phone number.

invalid.title: This link is no longer valid
invalid.description: It may have expired or been mistyped. You can still look the order up by code and phone number.

timeline.workshopEmpty: No diary entries yet. Workshop photos appear here once your piece is being cut and sewn.
timeline.photoAlt: Your ao dai in the workshop
timeline.measureAtStudio: Measurements will be taken when you visit the atelier.
timeline.addressLocked: The order is with the carrier — the address can no longer change.

amounts.codRemainder: The balance is paid in cash on delivery.

payment.title: Pay by VietQR transfer
payment.description: Open your banking app and scan — the amount and reference are pre-filled. The atelier confirms during working hours.
payment.contentHint: Keep the reference exactly so the payment is matched automatically

edit.otpDescription: To protect your order, we text a 6-digit code to the order's phone number ({phone}). The code works once and unlocks editing for 15 minutes.
edit.verifiedDescription: Verified. Changes are saved to the order right away.

thankYou.title: Thank you for trusting Thiên Canh with your ao dai
thankYou.description: Your order is in. A progress link has been sent to your email and phone.
thankYou.keepCode: Keep this code with your phone number to look the order up any time.
thankYou.depositTitle: Pay a {amount} deposit so we can start cutting
thankYou.codNote: You pay in cash on delivery. We will call to confirm within 24 working hours.
thankYou.emailNote: No email? Check your spam folder, or look the order up by code on the Order lookup page.
thankYou.invalidDescription: This thank-you link has expired or is wrong. You can still look the order up by code and phone number.

claim.eyebrow: Save this order to an account
claim.title: All it takes is a password
claim.description: Your name, phone, address and measurements are already on this order. Create an account so you never retype measurements and see every order in one place.
claim.sendCode: Text a code to the order's phone
claim.codeFirst: Enter the verification code before creating the account.
claim.existsTitle: You already have a Thiên Canh account
claim.existsDescription: The details on this order belong to an existing account. Please sign in to see it and keep your measurements.
claim.createdDescription: This order now lives in your account, with your address and measurements. Your email is saved as unverified — verify it under Personal info.

empty.title: No orders yet
empty.description: Once you order, your orders and tailoring progress will show here.
empty.track: Look up an order placed as a guest

account.notFoundDescription: The order doesn't exist or doesn't belong to this account.
account.editHint: Need to change measurements or the address? We'll text a verification code to the order's phone.

orders.label: Orders
orders.subtitle: Track your orders, remaining deposits and the tailoring progress of each piece.

addresses.label: Address book
addresses.subtitle: Delivery addresses used at checkout — add, edit or choose your default.
